label: TAPM + BPDA-CHO · single-net design
description: Single-net dia imine starting model from pyCOFBuilder. Explicit atoms and attachment graph checked. Cell and packing are unrelaxed.

audit.method: All-element explicit-H adjacency isomorphism after cutting uniquely identified short N–CH imine junctions, plus complete precursor-minus-water atom balance.
audit.bond_order_limit: CIF does not contain chemical bond orders; coordinate-inferred adjacency and explicit H are checked against the chosen imine product. No experimental structure assignment.
